title: Implement gated candidate, rehearsal, tag, and publication orchestration
description:
This leaf exclusively owns every release-execution workflow/job graph and composes the prerequisite authority primitive through its fixed interface; no account-side setting or primitive implementation is duplicated.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: This leaf is the exclusive owner of `.github/workflows/` candidate, escrow, rehearsal, final-auth/recovery, npm, GHCR and final-GitHub execution YAML; workflow triggers, permissions, needs/job DAG, constant concurrency group, transition/root/escrow/tag-manifest schemas and cross-workflow hosted fixtures live here. It changes no App/ruleset/environment/immutable-release account configuration and does not reimplement the fixed-ref authority primitive.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each candidate/final tag job calls the documented authority interface with exact typed inputs and validates its structured outputs; parsed-contract fixtures fail if workflows bypass it, mint App tokens themselves, construct refs independently, or duplicate its unit-fixture concerns. The authority leaf remains a dependency and file ownership is disjoint.
- [hard] REQ-03: Order is freeze ID → candidate handoff/annotated tag → push-owned event completion ID → validation/producers/root → immutable public candidate-prerelease escrow → rehearsal from escrow → fresh final preflight/MSRV/prepared → annotated final tag/completion → direct npm-publish prepared/OIDC/completed → GHCR/final GitHub by exact tag/npm/escrow identities. No ref/name/listing authority or pre-tag final-v1 channel mutation exists.
- [hard] REQ-04: The protocol pins artifact/attestation Actions, uses unique overwrite-forbidden 90-day records, and defines candidate-root, transition, escrow, rehearsal and compact tag-manifest schemas with every exact producer/run/identity/digest/parent needed for Actions-410 recovery. Exact-ID/API/attestation readers reject foreign, expired or substituted inputs; listings only check consistency.
- [hard] REQ-05: Transition schemas cover candidate tag/escrow, final tag, direct npm, GHCR and final GitHub. Prepared precedes mutation; readback precedes completion. Stale absent-final-tag preparation is superseded with fresh preflight/MSRV; exact existing tag may recovery-complete. Tag creation is irreversible.
- [hard] REQ-06: Every final mutator/recovery entry point declares literal `jit-v1.0.0-publication` with `cancel-in-progress:false` before live read and holds it through completion upload. Pending replacement requires explicit same-parent redispatch; no mutating subjob escapes and running mutators are never cancelled.
- [hard] REQ-07: Parsed-YAML and hosted cross-workflow fixtures own serialization, pending replacement, push-owned completion propagation, fresh absent-tag authorization, exact-existing-tag recovery, Actions-410 escrow recovery, parent/escrow mismatch, unsafe retry and source-mutation cases. These fixtures compose—but do not duplicate—the authority primitive's unit/negative suite.
- [hard] REQ-08: Post-tag workflows have actions:read and never actions:write; default contents are read-only, fixed-tag App authority is reachable only through the primitive, and release-publishing permissions are isolated. Endpoint fixtures reject published release/asset mutation and verify immutable escrow/final releases.

## Notes

Blast radius: `.github/workflows/` release/candidate/escrow/rehearsal/final-publication execution YAML, job DAG/concurrency/permissions, artifact/root/transition/escrow/tag-manifest schemas, cross-workflow API/attestation/release verifiers and hosted fixtures only; account-side settings and fixed-ref primitive files are excluded.
